name: Revolt of Inaros II
alt: Egyptian revolt against Achaemenid Persia (460-454 BC)

predecessors.name: Twenty-seventh Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: the Nile Delta around Sais and the Libyan coast from Mareia

successors.name: Twenty-seventh Dynasty of Egypt
successors.text: the Delta around Sais, retaken by Megabyzus in 454

ledger.x: 460: Inaros II raises Libyans and the western Delta against Persia.
460: the rebels meet the Persian army and besiege the Memphis citadel.
454: the revolt is crushed: Megabyzus "finally defeated" Inaros and his Athenian allies.
454: the rebel kingdom of Inaros II ends; he died c.

wars.name: Revolt of Inaros II
wars.outcome: The revolt failed; the Athenian fleet and army were lost on Prosopitis after an eighteen-month siege.

certainty.note: No frontier is given; the land is "the part of the Nile Delta around Sais" and the Libyan coast.
